Q5217.reason: Costco's acceptance was expressly conditional on the loading charge, so under UCC 2-207(1) it is a counteroffer, not an acceptance with proposed additions, and Rainmaking never accepted it.

Q6156.reason: The company was a party to the deposition and had the opportunity and a similar motive to cross-examine on the falsified reports, so FRE 804(b)(1) applies to the unavailable engineer's testimony.

Q8413.reason: In Al-Adsani v. UK the ECtHR held 9–8 that granting state immunity did not breach Article 6, so immunity prevailed over access to court in that case.
